todos: [P1] AUDIT-IPC-VALIDATION-01: complete channel-specific runtime schemas for every IPC handler with input, remove any from touched Preload contracts, and guard against direct ipcMain registration. The 2026-09-22 attempt was reverted after ingest:file rejected its test payload twice; first reconcile the actual handler signature, Preload arguments, and fixture before retrying.

[P1] SETTINGS-DIAGNOSTICS-RACE-01: in an isolated Electron startup with a valid settings.json defaultModel of offline-test:latest, the file was later rewritten with bge-m3:latest. Investigate useDiagnostics scanning before settings bootstrap finishes and prevent an automatic model choice from overwriting a persisted explicit choice. The settings bootstrap E2E was stopped after two identical failures on 2026-09-22.

[P1] AUDIT-COLD-START-MAIN-01: the new intercepted E2E proves zero Chromium external requests during Renderer remount, but interception starts after Electron creates the first window. Add first-process-start interception for Main and Renderer before claiming zero automatic external requests on a full cold start.

[P2] AUDIT-SETTINGS-BOOTSTRAP-01: test filesystem/localStorage one-shot migration, language and wizard state, and serialized/coalesced writes under rapid changes after SETTINGS-DIAGNOSTICS-RACE-01 is fixed. User confirmed settings.json takes precedence when legacy localStorage keys also exist.

[P2] OLLAMA-THINKING-GPTOSS-LIVE-01: when a GPT-OSS model is available locally, verify its actual Ollama family/capabilities and behavior in the app, confirm Settings shows only the level-only compatibility note (no false off switch), and confirm the runtime remains usable with the documented think:false default. Unit coverage is complete; this live model-specific check was not possible on 2026-09-22 because GPT-OSS was not installed.

[P2] AUDIT-RELEASE-GATES-01: the baseline fast suite passed 255 files/1982 tests; smoke, npm audit --omit=dev (0 vulnerabilities), and audit_codebase.ps1 -Fast passed on 2026-09-22. After the bundle changes, bundle UX E2E, Renderer network E2E, Sidecar ownership E2E (2/2), typecheck, static quality, dead code, docs, and smoke passed. Rerun the full fast suite after resolving IPC and settings, then close only after full cold-start coverage and architecture/security docs match the contracts.
